name: carousel-generator
description: Instagram carousel generator with nested block JSON, brand kits, assets and visual editor
long_description: Generates editable Instagram carousels as HTML and persists descriptive nested carousel.json documents with per-company assets. Includes a block editor with inline drag/reorder, golden-ratio calibration, multi brand-kit support, logo images, and PNG/PDF export.

tools.name: generate_carousel
tools.description: Create a new editable carousel HTML and optionally open it.

tools.name: list_carousels
tools.description: List persisted carousels grouped by company under ~/.carousel-generator/carousels/.

tools.name: load_carousel
tools.description: Load a persisted carousel.json v2 by company/slug, resolve assets, render editable HTML.

tools.name: save_carousel
tools.description: Upsert a nested carousel.json v2 (full object, slides, or meta/kit partials).

tools.name: delete_carousel
tools.description: Permanently delete a persisted carousel folder (carousel.json + assets).

tools.name: duplicate_carousel
tools.description: Duplicate a persisted carousel to another company and/or slug (A/B variants or working copies).

tools.name: export_pdf
tools.description: Export the carousel to a multi-page PDF with headless Chrome (print-to-pdf).

tools.name: delete_brand_kit
tools.description: Delete a personal brand kit under ~/.carousel-generator/brand/{empresa}/kit.json.

tools.name: review_slide_images
tools.description: Audit photos of a persisted carousel: per-slide texts, assigned photo, photoNeeds.

tools.name: set_slide_photo
tools.description: Replace the background photo of one slide in a persisted carousel.

tools.name: edit_slide
tools.description: Structured slide editor for a persisted carousel.

tools.name: set_slide_bg
tools.description: Change the background of a non-photo slide: kit gradient by name, custom CSS, or remove.

tools.name: set_carousel_meta
tools.description: Update carousel meta without touching slides: title, format, category, showCount.

tools.name: validate_carousel
tools.description: Quality dry-run on a persisted carousel (or unsaved slides): narrativeAudit + styleWarnings.

tools.name: save_brand_kit
tools.description: Save or merge a brand kit under ~/.carousel-generator/brand/{empresa}/kit.json.

tools.name: list_brand_kits
tools.description: List available brand kits: personal under ~/.carousel-generator/brand/, then repo kits in mcp/kits/.

tools.name: load_brand_kit
tools.description: Return the full JSON of a saved brand kit.

tools.name: brand_kit_from_url
tools.description: Generate a brand kit from a site homepage (fetch + heuristics, no deps) and optionally save it.

tools.name: carousel_from_url
tools.description: Create a draft carousel from an article URL (fetch + title/lead/data/image extraction).

tools.name: import_editor_state
tools.description: Import visual editor state (Push to MCP button) into carousel.json.

tools.name: render_preview
tools.description: Render the carousel to real PNGs with headless Chrome.

tools.name: social_copy
tools.description: Generate social post copy (captions, hooks, hashtags, altText) for a persisted carousel.
